question: How can impurity cover a self whose nature is consciousness and all-pervading?
premises: Impurity is supposed to cover the self.
The self is of the nature of consciousness.
An all-pervading being cannot undergo a covering action.
inference: The covering of a conscious, all-pervading self by impurity is incoherent.
plain_english: For how can the so-called impurity cover a self whose nature is consciousness? And where is there any act of covering for an all-pervading being?
